If I had to make my first $5K this month with digital products, I would NOT start by creating everything from scratch. Here’s the exact PLR path I’d follow: 1️⃣ Choose ONE audience. 2️⃣ Find ONE urgent problem they’re already searching for help with. 3️⃣ Purchase a quality PLR product that solves that problem. 4️⃣ Rebrand it with a new title, cover, examples, and my own voice. 5️⃣ Add a bonus that makes the offer feel like a no-brainer. 6️⃣ Price it at $57. At $57, I would need 88 sales to make $5,016. That breaks down to about 3 sales per day. Now, creating the product is only step one. You still need a strategy to get those three daily sales. Your digital product checkout is more than a payment button. 👀 If you sell ebooks, templates, courses, guides, Canva templates, or other digital products, you need to think about what happens after someone clicks “buy.” Before selling your first digital product, make sure you have: 1️⃣ Purchase terms — what the customer is actually agreeing to when they buy. 2️⃣ License & use restrictions — what they can and cannot do with your product. 3️⃣ Privacy Policy — especially if you’re collecting customer information. 4️⃣ Website/store terms — the rules governing purchases and use of your store. 5️⃣ Protection against unauthorized sharing & reselling — because your digital product should not become the internet’s free download. 😭 Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning.
